section_summary.extract_value: This section details an exploratory factor analysis (EFA) of the 15-item Portuguese Acceptance of Cosmetic Surgery Scale (ACSS), which yielded three factors: Intrapersonal, Social, and Consider. The study also examined sex differences using independent sample t-tests, finding no significant differences on the overall ACSS score or the Intrapersonal and Social factors, but women scored significantly higher on the Consider subscale.
